title: Constable / Beat Officer
canView: Assigned beat's hotspot list, patrol brief for their zone
canDo: Mark patrol as completed, submit ground observation note
cannot: View other districts, see full FIR details, edit records

title: Sub-Inspector / Investigating Officer
canView: Full FIR details assigned to them, repeat-offender matches
canDo: Add/update FIR notes, confirm or reject an AI-flagged match
cannot: Access drug risk reports, view other stations' FIRs

title: Station House Officer
canView: All FIRs, all patrol briefs, all hotspots within their PS jurisdiction
canDo: Approve patrol redeployment, escalate a flagged pattern to district
cannot: Cross-district data, drug intelligence report generation

title: DySP / Circle Officer
canView: All stations under their circle, cross-PS repeat-offender links
canDo: Approve cross-station gang linkage, reassign investigation
cannot: District-wide drug risk report, system configuration

title: Superintendent of Police
canView: All FIRs, all drug risk scores, all hotspots in their district
canDo: Generate monthly narcotics intelligence report, approve resource deployment
cannot: Access other districts' raw data, modify AI model/scoring logic

title: State Nodal Officer / IG (Intelligence)
canView: All districts, aggregated trend dashboards, cross-district gang networks
canDo: Approve inter-district task force alerts, export state-level reports
cannot: Edit individual FIR content (view-only at this level)

title: System Admin
access: Full technical access, no case data by default
canView: System logs, model performance, user accounts
canDo: Manage user roles, update AI prompts/thresholds, audit trail review
cannot: View FIR/victim personal data unless explicitly elevated for debugging (logged)
